WYOMING EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT CHEYENNE
STANLEY K. HATHAWAY
GOVERNOR
June 16, 1972
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director Bureau of Outdoor Recreation U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Hofe:
I have reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 which pertains to the use of off-road vehicles on the public lands which was sent to this office for review and comment. I wish to comment as follows:
The statement represents a thorough and objective evaluation of the predictable and probable environmental impacts of the proposed action from which it is clear that the alternatives to the proposed action would be unacceptable.
STATE CLEARINGHOUSE
Keith Osborn
Planning Coordinator
